entries.note: issue #58: originally "build a habit-forming feature that people get emotionally attached to". Under the pre-#58 formula this only resolved confidently because the query term "get" happened to substring-match "tarGET" inside a competing workflow's trigger text — a coincidental collision, not real signal — while "habit-forming" (hyphenated, one token) never matched the trigger's unhyphenated "habit" at all. Re-authored to use "habit" as a standalone word and drop the accidental "get"/"target" collision, so this entry tests real signal under the new router scoring (route-scoring.ts).
